correctness.rationale: Geodesic-permutation enumeration covers every 16-bit coloring and every shortest path, with an independent BFS check of all 24 accepted colorings, antipodal/orbit tests, and an explicit BFS-checked four-class partition of the five-cube. Face-extension proven by all pair cases. The lower bound derives from Korže–Vesel Theorem 3.14 (\(\mu_{\mathrm d}(Q_5)=10\)) giving \(3\cdot10<32\); the historical SAT/ILP computation is an acknowledged published dependency.

originality.rationale: Full source comparisons distinguish dual-set cardinality and ordinary visibility colorings from partitions into dual sets. The 2024 maximal-size theorem already implies the five-cube lower bound but not a four-class construction, and no inspected primary result classifies the 24 four-cube colorings. The four-cube classification is a finite exhaustive computation with a complete standalone checker, not an analytic-only proof.
